description: scenario.json of an experiment scenario folder: the intro card's texts and image, the pace, and whether a session may add anything on top of the .pkl (docs/reference/experiment-scenarios.md).

id.description: Equals the folder name, and differs from every built-in preset id.
id.title: Id

title.description: Heading of the intro card, and the scenario's name in a leg's label.
title.title: Title

description.description: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs.
description.title: Description

image.description: A file name in the same folder: .png, .jpg/.jpeg or .svg.
image.title: Image

seconds_per_step.description: Real seconds one step lasts at the speed slider's «Normal»; without it 2 s.
seconds_per_step.title: Seconds Per Step

locked.description: true: the scenario runs exactly as its .pkl says; a session adds nothing on top.
locked.title: Locked

title: Flatland Dispatcher experiment scenario
